commands.open: Opens a private ticket with the team.
commands.close: Closes this ticket and keeps a transcript.
commands.claim: Takes this ticket. Again to let it go.
commands.add: Lets a member see this ticket.
commands.remove: Takes a member out of this ticket.
commands.modmail: Sends your next DM to the team here.

panelDescription: {kind, select, support {Need help? React with {emoji} to open a ticket.} report {Something wrong in here? React with {emoji}. Only the team sees your ticket.} appeal {Want a decision looked at again? React with {emoji} to open an appeal.} other {React with {emoji} to open a ticket.}}
openDefault: {kind, select, support {Tell us what you need. The team will be with you shortly.} report {Tell us what happened and who was involved. Message links help.} appeal {Tell us which decision you want reviewed and why.} modmail {New modmail. Messages here go to the member by DM.} other {The team will be with you shortly.}}
internalHint: Start a message with {marker} to keep it internal.
subject: **Subject** {text}
alreadyOpen: {state, select, channel {You already have a ticket open: {channel}.} other {You already have a ticket open.}}
notSetUp: Tickets aren't set up here yet. An admin can add a panel in the dashboard.
openFailed: I couldn't create the ticket channel. Check my permissions on the category.
teamOnly: Only the ticket team can do that.
closeNotAllowed: Only the ticket team can close this one.
archived: -# The channel stays as an archive.
keepOpener: The person who opened the ticket stays.
badName: That name doesn't work for a channel. Use letters, numbers and dashes.
cannedUnknown: {known, select, yes {No canned reply called that. Try {names}.} other {No canned replies yet. Add them in the dashboard.}}
modmailSent: Sent to the **{guild}** team. Replies show up here.
modmailPick: Which community is this for? Reply with the number or part of the name.
modmailPage: Page {page} of {pages}. React with the arrows to turn the page.
modmailNoMatch: No community in the list matches **{query}**. Reply with a number or another part of the name.
modmailExpired: That list ran out after 5 minutes. Here is a fresh one.
modmailGone: **{guild}** can't take your message right now. Pick another.
modmailTryLater: I couldn't check your communities just now. Try again in a minute.
modmailReady: Write me here and it goes to the **{guild}** team.
modmailDmsClosed: I can't DM you. Allow DMs from this community and try again.
modmailOff: Modmail is off in this community.
modmailOpenHere: You already have modmail open here. Just write me in DMs.
modmailUnreachable: I couldn't reach them. Their DMs are closed.
ratingPrompt:
Your ticket #{number} in **{guild}** is closed.
{reactions, select, yes {How did it go? React with 1 to 5.} other {How did it go? Reply with a number from 1 to 5.}}
